title: elench claim predicate (v0.1, DRAFT)
description: Carried as the `predicate` of an in-toto Statement inside a DSSE envelope. The envelope supplies signer identity; this schema supplies producer identity, which is a different thing (R2). Status is NOT stored here — it is computed by folding the claim log. A `falsification` record is itself a claim with kind=falsification referencing a target.

id.description: Content address of the claim at creation. Stable across status changes (R1). Never reassigned.

kind.description: falsification/verification/supersession MUST carry `target`. residue-acceptance is the R5 human signature over named unevaluated claims.

target.description: Claims this record acts upon. Required unless kind=assertion.

form.description: predicate: machine-checkable, can gate. annotation: prose, searchable, CANNOT gate. Policies MUST NOT read annotations. The BC1 ratio is measured over this field.

expression.description: REQUIRED when form=predicate. A predicate without an executable expression is an annotation wearing a costume; validators MUST reject.

kind.description: R2. harness-observed may ONLY be emitted by the harness. See AGENTS.md. Policies may and generally should discriminate on this.

id.description: Harness build id, model id + version, or human key id.

hermeticity.description: BC3. Self-reported and therefore only as good as the producer. Present so policy can require a floor, not because it is trusted.

anchor.$comment: UNRESOLVED. See docs/anchoring.md. This shape is a placeholder that records all three candidate strategies simultaneously so E1 can measure which survives. Expect this object to change entirely.

tree.description: elench tree OID (content address of the tree state in the store, ADR-0001). Not a git commit OID.

contentDigest.description: Digest of the anchored span, normalised.

evidence.description: Empty for agent-asserted claims by default; that emptiness is the signal, not a gap to fill. A human-asserted claim with no evidence is authority without evidence, which is a legitimate and distinguishable state.

dependsOn.description: Premises. The transitive closure over this field IS the blast radius when something upstream is falsified. This field is the reason the project exists; if it is left empty in practice, revocation cannot propagate and the whole design collapses to per-claim status flags.
